instructions.title: Getting Started Guide
instructions.subtitle: Follow these 7 steps to optimize your academic planning experience
instructions.pageDescription: Follow these 7 steps to optimize your academic planning experience
instructions.startDescription: Ready to begin? Click above to start with step 1

step1.title: Add Extensions From Webstore
step1.description: Add the extension to extract your academic transcript in CSV/Excel format.

step2.title: Log in to MyDTU
step2.description: Sign in with your MyDTU account.

step3.title: Select Learning → Transcript
step3.description: Go to Learning and choose Transcript to access your grades.

step4.title: Open Student Grade Extractor
step4.description: Open the extension and select the Extractor menu to process your transcript.

step5.title: Click Extract & Download CSV
step5.description: Click Extract to download your transcript as a CSV file.

step6.title: Upload Transcript to the System
step6.description: Upload the CSV file to enable grade prediction and study plan recommendations.

step7.title: Adjust Parameters
step7.description: Customize your settings and view an overview of your current GPA and study progress.
